messages.content:
You are supporting a process mining research prototype.
Use only the synthetic scenario information provided below.
Do not invent company-specific system names, product names, confidential logs, internal metrics, or real organizational details.
Return valid JSON only. Do not wrap it in Markdown.

Scenario ID: S04
Scenario title: Defect Issue Triage and Risk Reporting
Initial workflow description:
When a defect occurs, the engineer reports it, discusses it with related teams, performs additional experiments, and decides how to improve the issue and communicate the risk.

Task: Clarify the workflow so that it can be reconstructed and assessed for automation opportunities.
Identify missing or ambiguous information and ask useful clarification questions for the domain expert.
Return JSON with this shape:
{"missing_information": [{"category": "short label", "gap": "missing information", "why_it_matters": "reason"}],
"clarification_questions": [{"id": "Q1", "question": "question for the domain expert", "targets": ["short label"]}]}
Ask exactly 6 questions with unique IDs Q1 through Q6.
Each question must have one main information need; avoid bundles of unrelated subquestions.
